name: Elysion
source: The story takes place in Pandora City. Confident, capable, and handsome, our hero is a divorced middle age man who simultaneously manages a decaying medical spa and an active and precarious love life, which includes a lustful affair with his sultry, married assistant. Bitter from the serial infidelity of his ex-wife, Bella, he had isolated himself not only from her, but his teen daughter, Teresa, an unwitting victim of circumstance.
translation: 故事发生在潘多拉城。我们的主人公自信、能干、英俊，是一位离婚的中年男子，他同时经营着一家破败的医疗水疗中心，同时也经营着积极而不稳定的爱情生活，其中包括与他性感的已婚助理的淫荡风流韵事。由于对前妻贝拉的一系列不忠感到痛苦，他不仅将自己与她隔离，而且还与他十几岁的女儿特蕾莎隔离，她是环境的无意受害者。
